name: lawlint
description: A linter for AI-generated legal and general text.

scripts.lint: bunx biome check apps/website packages/core packages/docx
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p apps/website/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/docx/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:ts: bun test --cwd packages/core && bun test --cwd packages/docx
